messages:
marie (docs): Heads-up: we're stabilizing the Python SDK surface over the next 90 days. This includes removing the compatibility shim that auto-normalizes older call patterns. Docs preview + migration guide are up for review: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/sdk-py-stabilize :eyes:

alek (sdk): TL;DR — shim removal means some call signatures that relied on implicit param coercion will error. We added a small CLI tool to analyze codebases and suggest fixes. Demo gist: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-migrate

devon (product): Timeline: announcement -> 90-day deprecation window -> 30-day removal notice -> GA removal. We're aiming to soft-roll in the hosted SDK next week for canary customers.

jamal (devex): Demo CLI usage (example):
```
# check your repo for shim usage
redwood-sdk-migrate --scan path/to/project --report report.json
# apply autofixes (opt-in)
redwood-sdk-migrate --apply path/to/project
```

samira (legal): Quick flag — make sure the migration guide includes a note about telemetry and what the CLI sends back. We need opt-out instructions in plain language.

marie (docs): Yep — added a telemetry section on the preview page. Short excerpt included in the guide: "CLI collects anonymized usage counts and stack traces for migration heuristics. Set REDWOOD_MIGRATE_TELEMETRY=0 to opt out."

alek (sdk): Patch note examples for breaking changes: we mapped old `client.generate(prompt=...)` where prompt could be list|str into explicit `client.generate(prompts=[...])`. We'll add adapter helpers for the most common patterns.

devon (product): Can we gate the removal for Dedicated customers behind a feature flag for one extra quarter? Some customers asked for longer runway.

alek (sdk): We can. Plan: default removal timeline stays 90 days, but Dedicated tenants can request a 90-day extension. Add to rollout doc.

jamal (devex): I'll coordinate a few "migration office hours" sessions and a short recorded walkthrough. Will post sign-up in #general tomorrow.

deploy-bot: docs-preview build succeeded: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/2109876543 (staging). SHA: abc1234.

ci-bot: migration-cli unit tests: 128 passed, 3 flaky (investigating). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/boards/migrate-cli/2109876543

marie (docs): Ask for reviewers: @alek (sdk), @jamal (devex), @samira (legal), @devon (product). If no major blockers, we'll publish the announcement next Tue and post the deprecation timeline in the public changelog. :thumbsup:

alek (sdk): ack — I'll follow up with a short snippet PR showing pre->post code diffs for the top 5 break types.

samira (legal): Approved language for privacy section; ping me if marketing wants a customer-facing blurb.

devon (product): Great — thanks all. Let's track blockers in the rollout doc and aim to keep the migration experience as frictionless as possible.

marie (docs): Final note: please do a quick scan of code samples in docs pages and flag any that rely on implicit shim behavior. I ran an automated search and attached a list in the preview build artifacts.

alek (sdk): Will do today.
